ownerDecision.scope: A first-party ZTZ-20 family in four stages: the ZTZ-100 Prototype missile testbed (its 2026-09-19 turret on docs/references/concepts/missile-turrets-20260919.json, its hull and gear rebuilt on the family base), the pre-production ZTZ-100 (rebuilt), the ZTZ-20 Prototype turret testbed (new) and the production ZTZ-20 (new, measured from scratch on the supplied model). concept.role: main battle tank: a 45 t next-generation MBT with an unmanned turret and a three-crew hull capsule

stages.ztz100_prototype: missile testbed (c. 2017): the family hull and capsule proved under a missile turret, flush crew hatches under its low platter
stages.ztz100: pre-production (c. 2020): the gun turret with its systems blanked or in trials form, the earlier 105 mm
stages.ztz20_prototype: turret testbed (c. 2021): the ZTZ-20 turret's new high-pressure 105 mm in an early mount, trial ballast for the pods, a fixed commander's periscope, no weapon station or hard-kill system yet
stages.ztz20: production (early 2020s): hard-kill launchers, ATGM weapon station, the coaxial machine gun moved to an armoured right-cheek housing, the ribbed brake, glacis tiles, slat cage

concept.rationale: A lighter MBT for southern hills, plateau roads and river crossings than the 50-plus-tonne ZTZ-99 family; an unmanned turret over a hull crew capsule for a low 2.30 m turret roof; a high-pressure 105 mm gun with a compact autoloader keeps the turret narrow, the matured round closing most of the gap to the 125 mm tanks; raked composite cheeks, flank pods, glacis tiles, three-band skirts and a slat cage, with active protection on the production turret.
concept.serviceClaim: none: the names, stages and dates are the game's design history; no fielded vehicle or documented programme is claimed

ztz20.silhouette: Production ZTZ-20: a long low hull under composite glacis tiles and three-band side skirts with a stern slat cage, carrying a low unmanned arrowhead turret of two raked cheek blocks round a narrow gun housing, flank pods, two hard-kill launcher towers and a twin-tube weapon station; the long 105 mm gun in an angular thermal sleeve behind a slotted brake

ztz100.silhouette: Pre-production ZTZ-100: the ZTZ-20 hull and arrowhead turret at an earlier step, a bare glacis, two-band skirts, a stern bin under its trials basket, blanked hard-kill seats, a plain 12.7 mm station, a cheek-bank cover plate and a telemetry mast; the 105 mm gun behind a round multi-baffle brake

ztz20_prototype.silhouette: ZTZ-20 Prototype: the first ZTZ-20 turret as a testbed fit on the family hull, the arrowhead cheeks and spine housing with trial ballast blocks where the armour pods go, a fixed commander's periscope, no weapon station, hard-kill system or smoke banks, a telemetry mast, and the new high-pressure 105 mm in an early bolted box mantlet, bare tube with fume extractor and slotted brake

requiredProof: Actual HIGH/LOW profile fixture (src/vehicles/profiles/ztz20Family.selftest.mjs): stage deltas in the part census, measured datums, staggered road-wheel stations, recessed bore, slat-cage air, the turret clear of the hull at every yaw with a negative control
Gun clearance over the hull at every yaw at the published depression curve (src/vehicles/ztz20GunClearance.selftest.mjs)
Declared datums and the complete envelope within 3% with generated fills loaded (tools/first-party-concept-check.mjs)
Anatomy freshness, sealed hull, track sweep, module and crew ownership, assets and centering, tests and build
Independent native views against this design contract; no source-fidelity score
